planos.01-kit: The woman hands the bamboo sticks and red paper to the children, they take them smiling. Static camera.
planos.02-lia: The girl talks excitedly and smiles, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.03-corre: The boy runs fast across the grass, the kite drags low behind him and does not lift. Tracking shot.
planos.04-kenji-bravo: The boy frowns, pants and complains, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.05-lia-tenta: The girl runs with the kite, it rises a little and falls back to the grass, the boy watches. Static camera.
planos.06-kenji-desiste: The boy sits with arms crossed, pouts and shakes his head, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.07-mei-chega: The woman walks slowly up the path toward the children, smiling. Static camera.
planos.08-mei-palavra: The woman speaks gently with a warm smile, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.09-mei-explica: The woman points to the sky and explains kindly, the children look up. Static camera.
planos.10-fengzheng: The kite flutters gently in the breeze, the golden dragon shimmers. Static camera.
planos.11-conserta: The three tie the ribbons on the kite tail carefully together. Static camera.
planos.12-kenji-respira: The boy inhales deeply, exhales calmly and speaks with a determined smile, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.13-espera: The two children wait quietly, then the wind starts to sway the grass and their clothes. Static camera.
planos.14-lia-solta: The girl shouts joyfully, wind blowing her hair, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.15-ceu: The red kite rises higher and higher in the blue sky, tail waving. Slow camera tilt up.
planos.16-kenji-uau: The boy looks up amazed, smiles wide and speaks happily, natural mouth movement. Static camera.
planos.17-versiculo: The three sit side by side looking up at the sky, a gentle breeze moves their hair. Static camera.
planos.18-por-do-sol: The red kite sways gently in the sunset sky. Static camera.
planos.19-resumo: The three smile at the camera, the girl waves, the kite sways above. Static camera, subtle motion.
